name: Plus / Delta (+ / Δ)

steps.text: Set the stage (3m): show the Prime Directive; one sentence on the sprint's aim.
Gather data (7m): silent notes into Plus and Delta.
Generate insights (10m): merge duplicates; keep every Delta precise.
Decide (8m): select exactly one Delta for the next iteration.
Close (2m): read the chosen Delta back; name its owner.

action: Exactly one Delta enters the next sprint as a backlog item with an owner and a review date; the Plus notes are read aloud, not ticketed.
provenance: Source protocol: the phases and minutes follow the written sequence in the source.

origin.note: A common check-in format; no documented originator.
